console.read.what: read back what a node's firmware has said, which is where the reply to anything typed at it arrives

params.name: node
params.what: the node whose scrollback to read; refused when it is absent, unknown, or runs no firmware

console.read.answers: `lines` is how many the node has said since its console was attached and `tail` is the last two hundred of them, so the two disagree on a node that has been running a while.

example.what: read what a node has been saying

console.type.what: run a line at a node's own firmware console, which answers what the node says rather than what it sent, and is the question asked when a node is not behaving as its configuration claims

params.name: node
params.what: the node whose console to type at; refused when it is absent, unknown, or runs no firmware

params.name: command
params.what: the line to type, sent with a carriage return and newline after it; refused when it is absent or empty

console.type.answers: The node's reply is not in this answer: it lands in the scrollback when the engine next steps, and is read with `console.read`. On a paused clock this steps the engine sixty times so the reply arrives anyway, but while a sweep owns the clock the replies come back empty.

example.what: ask a node what it believes it is called
